headlines.text: On this day in 2026, Darby Allin vs. Konosuke Takeshita went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.91 ? a match fans still talk about. This stood as the 80th match in AEW World Heavyweight Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title. With Okada pulled from the match due to his New Japan tour, Takeshita stepped in as a replacement challenger, but Allin's Coffin Drop was enough to retain ? setting up MJF finally signing a Hair vs. Title contract for Double or Nothing.
That Wednesday in 2020, Brodie Lee announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Christopher Daniels, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.35.
It was 2022 when PAC made their return to AEW television after 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
